name: coverage-okta
objective: Coverage recette for the okta domain: the privileged role identity_admin exercises every one of its 13 catalogued actions, asserting the documented posture (12 escalate, 1 deny). Proves the catalog/engine emit the right verdict for each action of this domain.
teaching: Even the identity_admin never gets a silent ALLOW on a sensitive okta action: governed actions escalate to a human (I6); pure-deny actions stay denied for everyone. The whole sweep is replayable for audit (I4).
